$comment: The 20-session idle fixture of contract §11.1 (10 watched Claude, 5 Conversation, 3 Terminal, 2 turn-based). The harness materializes the 10 watched sessions itself: idle stand-in processes with registry rows and transcripts in a temp HOME; two of them carry the F-03 hostile argv and the env-value canary (scripts/gates/fixtures/hostile-argv.json), so the same run feeds T-priv-argv / T-priv-3 (canary-scan over GILDE_HOME afterwards). The 10 Gilde-owned sessions are started in the app against the fake vendor binaries (fake_claude, fake_agent from `cargo build --features test-fixtures`) on PATH.
